messages:
Maya (Design): uploaded a compact mock for the autoscale panel: min/max, burst toggle, GPU pool picker, and SLO slider. looking for quick UX + accessibility feedback. figma: https://figma.com/file/ux-autoscale
Alex (Product): main ask: make SLO less intimidating for new users. default to a Balanced preset (100 ms) with short helper text.
Samir (Eng): FYI pools are g4, l4, a100. dropdown should show approx qps and $/hr per pool; backend can return these values.
Maya (Design): thinking two-line rows in dropdown: "g4" then small "~600 qps · $2.80/hr". ok?
Leah (Accessibility): a11y notes: 1) slider keyboard: arrows = 1% step, PgUp/PgDn = 10%. 2) increase secondary text contrast to 4.5:1. 3) GPU dropdown must support typeahead and aria-activedescendant.
Samir (Eng): guardrail request: if SLO < 60 ms and pool = l4, show inline note: "Estimated p95 ~120 ms with this pool." backend will compute estimate.
Maya (Design): draft microcopy: "Note: estimated p95 with selected pool is ~120 ms. Consider a higher-performance pool or enabling burst." Leah any tone tweaks?
Leah (Accessibility): prefer neutral phrasing and mark the note with role="status" so screen readers announce it.
Jon (SRE): burst tooltip: "Temporary burst capacity uses spare GPU slots for short spikes; billed while active. Default cap = 2x reserved." also require telemetry event: capacity.burst.triggered {team_id, pool, duration_s}.
Samir (Eng): will emit that event when burst allocation succeeds.
Maya (Design): about min/max defaults: team suggests min=1, max=16, but UI should show a recommended band from org history with one-click apply (e.g., "Recommended: min 2 — max 8"). API: /orgs/{id}/autoscale/suggest.
Alex (Product): confirmation required if new min > current instances: show "Apply and migrate (may restart)" vs "Apply without migration".
Maya (Design): i'll update figma with contrast fixes, aria notes, revised guardrail copy, burst copy, and recommended range UI. ops-bot will post when done.
ops-bot: uploaded updated figma: https://figma.com/file/ux-autoscale?node-id=55 :thumbsup:
Alex (Product): acceptance criteria draft: 1) SLO slider keyboard accessible + labeled; 2) GPU pool rows show qps and $/hr + typeahead; 3) burst toggle with tooltip and billing note; 4) guardrail appears with role=status when triggered; 5) recommended min/max shown with one-click apply.
Maya (Design): thanks all  i'll push final spec tomorrow. :sparkles:
